title: CMS Blocks
description: Manage storefront content blocks and their display order.

help.title: About CMS Blocks
help.overview: CMS blocks are the sections of the storefront, such as a hero, a slider, or an announcement. The shop loads active blocks whose dates include now, ordered by position from lowest to highest. Type and title are required. Choosing a type shows the fields that type needs.

sections.title: How the storefront picks them
sections.body: Position is the display order. Reorder on this page writes those positions. A block outside its start or end stays saved but is not sent to the shop.
items: Type chooses the layout: hero, slider, featured collection, trending, best sellers, flash sale, announcement, custom HTML, video, grid, category showcase, or promotional section.
Visibility can limit desktop, mobile, and tablet, and can list regions. A new block defaults to all three devices.
Deleting a block is a soft delete and it can be restored.

reorderDescription: Drag blocks to change their display order on the storefront.
